title: Think as You Like but Behave Like Others
hook: Jason keeps the radical method off the grant slide so the experiment survives the room.
counterintuition: Direct force looks honest, but it can spend leverage too early. The sharper move is to handle surface conformity while the other side is still reading the surface.
tryThisNow: Find one decision you are about to make public. Move one detail so surface conformity works for you before anyone argues over the larger issue.
keyTakeaway: Protect independent thought by adapting outward behavior to the room's tolerance.
